title: Final Accelerations
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expressions for the accelerations of m1 and m2 must be provided.

title: Final Tension
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the tension in the string must be included.

title: Minimum Friction Coefficient
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the minimum coefficient of friction must be derived.

title: Equations of Motion
description: Important Criteria: The equations of motion for m1 and m2 must be correctly set up and solved.

title: Force Analysis
description: Important Criteria: A clear analysis of the forces acting on the inclined plane must be provided.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign errors in the equations of motion or force analysis must be avoided.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units must be consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: Consideration of limiting cases or special scenarios should be discussed.
